entries.note: i18n audit round 1 of PR #4211 (feat/heavy-slot-wait) on base head 117f0383b, 2026-11-18. Target fr/cli.services_heavy.json sha256 be65ebb3e3d006a6fbb936f81e3002926e3390c8ee06f2b859b8cea6274a0ba1 (9/9 keys) after auditor fixes. Semantic read of all 9 values against i18n/glossary.md, the locale style guide and the en context sidecar: wait never takes a slot, run holds it exactly for the command's lifetime, status shows pid/age/command; subcommand names wait/run/status, pid, `--`, `lop services heavy run -- make test`, {slot} {holder} {age} {command} {wait_seconds} {env_name} preserved; holder keeps two leading spaces. C2 (MINOR, fixed by auditor): status «l’ancienneté» (reads as seniority) -> «la durée de détention» to match the context note (age = how long the holder has held the slot).
